notes.text: Placing the filing on Friday offered Undo.
After jumping between weeks, the no-kids week still shows Family 2h.
No alternating-week template: she would rebuild the kids-week and no-kids-week split by hand every two weeks.
Hours audit: Work 30h = 2 placed + 28 left, Family 20h = 0 placed + 20 left, Self (garden) 3h = 0 placed + 3 left
The app never showed an overbooking or over-capacity message.
